basis.kind: Requirement-derived local decision oracles, not operational validation
basis.sourceReview: Accepted 2026-11-18 against the source-checked canonical claims, controls and capabilities. This accepts the documentary basis for derived framework decisions, not a deployment or live configuration.
qualifications: C-01/C-03/C-11/C-13/C-16 and the normative controls are derived framework positions, not universal Microsoft or legal mandates.
C-02/N-03 require actual authority-path independence; another tenant does not eliminate shared credentials, privilege, recovery or Entra-service dependencies.
K07 does not equate residency, tenant count or key custody with sovereignty; K08 does not establish full or service-independent recovery.
N-05/K10 distinguish required local functions and duration from tested capability, platform labels and online tenant count.
N-14 requires local safety authority; N-26 excludes known mandatory conflicts while unknown mandatory facts prevent a positive default.
All tests are local synthetic evaluations. No operational configuration, recovery exercise or physical process was verified.

cases.name: One tenant is a review candidate only when all required declarations are present
cases.requirement: C-01 and N-26: select among configurations meeting mandatory requirements; no deployment approval.

cases.name: Acquisition frequency alone does not require more tenants
cases.requirement: C-01/C-03: transition context is not an unmet isolation requirement.

cases.name: Acquisition plus an actual unmet requirement supports a boundary review
cases.requirement: C-01/C-03: a documented unmet requirement, not the frequency, justifies T2.

cases.name: Local keys with sufficient controls can remain in one tenant
cases.requirement: C-11/K07: local cryptographic authority is not equivalent to tenant separation.

cases.name: An unverified key-control assertion is not a conclusive result
cases.requirement: C-11/K07: evaluate actual operator, processing and key controls.

cases.name: An extra tenant cannot cure known unmet sovereignty controls
cases.requirement: C-11/K07/N-26: reject the failed control configuration regardless of tenant count.

cases.name: Regulatory labels with satisfiable controls do not require more tenants
cases.requirement: C-01/C-11: a legal-entity or regulatory category is not proof of incompatible controls.

cases.name: Genuinely incompatible mandatory controls reject the single-tenant option
cases.requirement: C-01/N-26: an actual unmet requirement excludes that alternative.

cases.name: Organizational autonomy alone does not require a separate identity authority
cases.requirement: C-01/C-02: business preference and authentication independence are different facts.

cases.name: Independent identity requirement with shared authority is excluded
cases.requirement: C-02/N-03: shared authentication or privilege paths defeat the independence requirement.

cases.name: Independent identity with unknown paths needs evidence
cases.requirement: C-02/N-03: a tenant label cannot stand in for examined authority paths.

cases.name: Declared independent identity paths permit a T3 review candidate
cases.requirement: C-02/N-03: independence requires explicit authority-path declarations, still subject to validation.

cases.name: S3 local capability does not automatically change the tenant pattern
cases.requirement: N-05/K10: local independent functions and tenant count are orthogonal.

cases.name: S4 is a disconnected overlay and not another online tenant
cases.requirement: N-05/K10: disconnected local control planes are not an Entra availability guarantee.

cases.name: S3 with unknown upstream dependencies cannot be called independent
cases.requirement: N-05/K10: DNS, cloud, federation, MFA and SOC dependencies must be examined.

cases.name: S4 with declared upstream dependencies is excluded
cases.requirement: N-05/K10: a required independent function cannot retain an unavailable upstream dependency.

cases.name: Known missing outage tests are not continuity readiness
cases.requirement: N-05/N-26: selecting a tier does not implement its functions.

cases.name: Independent recovery with shared authority is excluded
cases.requirement: C-07/K08: continuity and restoration authority are separate requirements.

cases.name: A known recovery cycle cannot be described as ready
cases.requirement: C-07/K08/N-26: reject a circular trusted-restoration dependency even where shared authority is acceptable.

cases.name: Unknown recovery paths require evidence even with a managed label
cases.requirement: C-07/C-16: a label does not establish a trusted restoration path.

cases.name: Safety-critical OT at S0 still requires local safety declarations
cases.requirement: C-13/N-14: local safe-state operation must not be a warning-only cloud dependency.

cases.name: Missing local OT authority is a mandatory failure
cases.requirement: C-13/N-14: cloud administration is not local operational authority.

cases.name: An unsafe automated response is excluded despite local authority
cases.requirement: C-13/N-14: cyber response must respect the local safety case.

cases.name: No local OT fallback excludes the configuration at S0
cases.requirement: C-13/N-14: safe operation or shutdown cannot depend only on cloud response.

cases.name: Reviewed local safety overlay can coexist with enterprise S0
cases.requirement: C-13/N-14: distinguish local safety functions from enterprise tenant and continuity dimensions.

cases.name: A developing label does not erase concrete operating evidence
cases.requirement: C-16/N-26: assess prerequisites rather than equating a maturity category with implementation.

cases.name: An automated label cannot compensate for missing response capability
cases.requirement: C-16/N-26: staffing, monitoring, response and recovery must be evidenced separately.

cases.name: A managed label alone cannot establish operating readiness
cases.requirement: C-16/N-26: unknown operating facts remain unknown despite a favorable self-description.

cases.name: Context labels cannot override a contradictory recovery path
cases.requirement: C-01/C-07/C-11/N-26: mandatory conflicts precede any topology preference.

cases.name: Known recovery conflict remains excluded alongside unknown continuity facts
cases.requirement: N-26: unknowns do not soften an already-known mandatory conflict.
